description:
Explain what a family is likely to see across a list of schools and why, in plain language. An explanation for a counselor to walk a family through, never an official determination, and the output says so.

Cost: about 73 credits (~$0.073) per call.

context.description: Household situation that affects the estimate.

fafsaContext.description: What is already known from the FAFSA, including the SAI if it has come back.

income.description: Household income, as the family stated it.

repayContext.description: What the family has said about borrowing and what they can carry.

schoolCount.description: How many schools are being compared.

schoolSummaries.description: One line per school: name, cost of attendance, anything already known about the offer.

studentName.description: The student this is about. Used in the output text.

name: aid
title: Aid estimate explainer
